rules: An ARCHITECTON claim is never copied to RDX without a normalization record.
architecton_evidence_level and RDX evidence_level are separate fields.
APPROVED requires a concrete integer rdx_evidence_level from 0 to 8.
No normalization may invent a source, execution, calculation, simulation or test.
Normalization does not publish a Decision Pack.
Human review remains required for material publishable RDX claims.
